summary.result: Test results show that the unit weights of PNA concrete are decreased 1 % ∼3% and the highest strength is achieved by 5% PNA filled PNA concrete.
summary.background: Materials used for this experiment are PNA, normal portland cement, natural fine and coarse aggregate.
